description: Evidence-based readiness dashboard using only current PostgreSQL rows. No simulated data.

panels.description: Hours since the latest real telemetry row. Green is under 1 hour; red is over 24 hours.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX("time"))) / 3600.0, 1) AS value
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring});

FROM public.ldi_alarm_log
WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})

panels.description: Percent of real alarm rows whose error code can be resolved by the current alarm master.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.alarm_code IS NOT NULL)
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
  1
) AS value
FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m
  ON a.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_code::TEXT
WHERE a.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND a.equipmentid IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})

panels.title: errorcode ↔ alarm_code

panels.description: Separates the missing board_id field from usable board progress fields (board_no and total_board). A zero Board ID value is a source-data gap, not a missing production-progress signal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(board_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "Board ID",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE board_no IS NOT NULL AND total_board IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "Board Progress"
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring});

panels.title: Board Identifier / Progress Coverage

panels.description: Row-level completeness of PE and JE4 for selected machines.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(pe_1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "PE",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(je_4) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "JE4"
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring});

panels.title: pe_1 + je_4 — Coverage

panels.description: Actual telemetry rows received in each five-minute bucket. Gaps indicate no stored rows, not simulated downtime.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('5 minutes', "time") AS "time",
  eqp_id AS metric,
  COUNT(*)::NUMERIC AS value
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE $__timeFilter("time")
  AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: ldi_data — Row Count (5-min)

panels.description: Real row counts and field coverage per selected machine.

targets.rawSql:
WITH telemetry AS (
  SELECT
    d.eqp_id,
    MIN(d.factory) AS factory,
    MIN(d.process) AS process,
    COUNT(*) AS telemetry_rows,
    MAX(d."time") AS latest_telemetry,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(d.pe_1) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pe_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(d.je_1) / COUNT(*), 1) AS je13_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(d.je_4) / COUNT(*), 1) AS je4_pct
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  WHERE d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY d.eqp_id
),
alarms AS (
  SELECT
    a.equipmentid AS eqp_id,
    MIN(a.factory) AS factory,
    MIN(a.process) AS process,
    COUNT(*) AS alarm_rows,
    MAX(a.logdate) AS latest_alarm
  FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
  WHERE a.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND a.equipmentid IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY a.equipmentid
),
machines AS (
  SELECT eqp_id FROM telemetry
  UNION
  SELECT eqp_id FROM alarms
)
SELECT
  x.eqp_id AS "Machine",
  COALESCE(t.factory, a.factory) AS "Factory",
  COALESCE(t.process, a.process) AS "Process",
  COALESCE(t.telemetry_rows, 0) AS "Telemetry Rows",
  t.latest_telemetry AS "Latest Telemetry",
  t.pe_pct AS "PE %",
  t.je13_pct AS "JE1-3 %",
  t.je4_pct AS "JE4 %",
  COALESCE(a.alarm_rows, 0) AS "Alarm Rows",
  a.latest_alarm AS "Latest Alarm"
FROM machines x
LEFT JOIN telemetry t USING (eqp_id)
LEFT JOIN alarms a USING (eqp_id)
ORDER BY x.eqp_id

panels.title: ldi_data + ldi_alarm_log — Coverage

panels.description: Global comparison of machine identifiers in telemetry and alarm sources. This intentionally ignores dashboard filters so unmatched IDs stay visible.

targets.rawSql:
WITH telemetry AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT eqp_id FROM public.ldi_data
), alarms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT equipmentid AS eqp_id FROM public.ldi_alarm_log
), ids AS (
  SELECT eqp_id FROM telemetry
  UNION
  SELECT eqp_id FROM alarms
)
SELECT
  i.eqp_id AS "Machine ID",
  (t.eqp_id IS NOT NULL) AS "In Telemetry",
  (a.eqp_id IS NOT NULL) AS "In Alarm",
  CASE
    WHEN t.eqp_id IS NOT NULL AND a.eqp_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'MATCHED'
    WHEN t.eqp_id IS NULL THEN 'ALARM ONLY'
    ELSE 'TELEMETRY ONLY'
  END AS "Mapping Status"
FROM ids i
LEFT JOIN telemetry t USING (eqp_id)
LEFT JOIN alarms a USING (eqp_id)
ORDER BY "Mapping Status", i.eqp_id;

panels.title: eqp_id ↔ equipmentid — Gaps

panels.description: Every distinct alarm code from the real log and whether it resolves against the supplied alarm master.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  a.errorcode::TEXT AS "Alarm Code",
  COUNT(*) AS "Rows",
  CASE WHEN m.alarm_code IS NULL THEN 'UNMAPPED' ELSE 'MATCHED' END AS "Mapping",
  COALESCE(m.alarm_msg, '') AS "Message",
  COALESCE(m.alarm_type, '') AS "Severity"
FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_code::TEXT
GROUP BY a.errorcode, m.alarm_code, m.alarm_msg, m.alarm_type
ORDER BY "Rows" DESC;

panels.title: errorcode ↔ alarm_code — Gaps

panels.description: Shows why telemetry rows cannot yet be treated as guaranteed board-completion events: board_id is missing and some MO + board_no keys repeat.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  eqp_id AS "Machine",
  COUNT(*) AS "Telemetry Rows",
  COUNT(DISTINCT (mo, board_no)) AS "Unique MO + Board No",
  COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (mo, board_no)) AS "Duplicate Board Keys",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(board_id) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "Board ID %",
  COUNT(DISTINCT mo) AS "Distinct MO",
  MIN(board_no) AS "Min Board No",
  MAX(board_no) AS "Max Board No"
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY eqp_id
ORDER BY "Duplicate Board Keys" DESC, eqp_id;

panels.title: mo + board_no + board_id + log_id — Quality

panels.description: Capability is inferred only from existing rows. ALL ZERO or CONSTANT means verify the machine specification; it is not automatically classified as a fault.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  d.eqp_id AS "Machine",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(d.pe_1) > 0 THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'NO DATA' END AS "PE1-6",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(d.je_1) > 0 THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'NO DATA' END AS "JE1-3",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(d.je_4) > 0 THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'NO DATA' END AS "JE4",
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d.air_vacuum) > 1 THEN 'VARIABLE SIGNAL'
    WHEN COUNT(d.air_vacuum) = 0 THEN 'NO DATA'
    WHEN BOOL_AND(d.air_vacuum = 0) THEN 'ALL ZERO - VERIFY'
    ELSE 'CONSTANT - VERIFY'
  END AS "Vacuum",
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d.scan_speed) > 1 THEN 'VARIABLE SIGNAL'
    WHEN COUNT(d.scan_speed) = 0 THEN 'NO DATA'
    ELSE 'CONSTANT - VERIFY'
  END AS "Scan Speed",
  CASE WHEN MAX(a.equipmentid) IS NOT NULL THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'NO MATCHING ID' END AS "Alarm Source"
FROM public.ldi_data d
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT equipmentid FROM public.ldi_alarm_log) a ON a.equipmentid = d.eqp_id
WHERE d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY d.eqp_id
ORDER BY d.eqp_id;
